t: Vladimir Putin has arrived in Tajikistan for a working visit
d: Vladimir Putin was met at the steps of his plane by President of Tajikistan Emomali Rahmon.

t: Greetings to the current and former staff of the United Aircraft Corporation
d: Vladimir Putin extended his greetings to the staff and veterans of the United Aircraft Corporation on the company’s 20th anniversary.

t: Greetings to the participants of the 20th Transport of Russia International Forum and Exhibition
d: Vladimir Putin extended his greetings to the participants of the 20th Transport of Russia International Forum and Exhibition.

t: Conversation with President of Tajikistan Emomali Rahmon
d: During the talks, the parties discussed key issues related to the further development of the strategic partnership and alliance between Russia and Tajikistan, as well as current international and regional issues.
